definition: per output frame, the sets of layer reads (layer, clip frame index or none outside the clip, time in seconds): plugin side the SMART_RENDER pixel checkouts resolved through their pre-render checkout (pre-render checkouts when a record has no pixel checkout), rewrite side the VFX_CALL_RECORD read lines; layers the case does not set are left out (the harness answers them with size 0, they have no pixels)
limits: parameter sample times are not recorded on the rewrite side: plugin param reads are counted, not compared
a classic (non smart) render path has its layers handed over in params[]; those reads are added as implicit reads at each frame time
